frontmatter.name: website-self-review
frontmatter.description: Audits and iteratively improves a website the agent has just built from a raw user prompt. Use this skill after any website, landing page, or web app build is first complete, and whenever the user asks to review, polish, fix, or improve a site. It finds what works, what is broken, what is misplaced, and what needs improvement, then fixes issues in ranked order, with a hard limit of 5 improvement passes so it never loops forever.
